channel: Superhive; private/demo waitlist or early access where policy-compliant
method: Build a 2-minute working prototype + product page mockup; show to Blender groups without spam; ask for refundable pre-order only if platform and consumer terms permit. Better direct test: publish free functional demo with paid upgrade listing and track paid upgrades.
go_no_go_criteria: 10 paid upgrades or 30 qualified email signups in 30 days; otherwise stop / revise. Views and likes alone do not pass.
guardrail: No custom build work until 10 paid commitments or strong preorder evidence.

method: Select one obsolete part with public repair discussions; produce 3 tested variants, publish exact compatibility table, fit photos and free preview drawing. Three listings are a test set, not a broad catalog.
go_no_go_criteria: At least 5 sales across 3 SKUs and <10% fit-related support/refund within 30 days; otherwise pause the category.
guardrail: Do not infer sales from reviews on unrelated physical listings.

method: Offer a genuinely reusable, versioned starter pack; show a transparent compatibility matrix. Use an optional non-customized demo video/screenshot; capture preorders or listing orders.
go_no_go_criteria: At least 5 purchases and average review ≥4.5 after 10 reviews, with median support under 10 min/order; otherwise stop.
guardrail: Keep base download complete without paid setup service; remove bespoke support.
